strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is... Getter Robo G...
Well, now... this thing is...
Looks tough. I like it.
Almost done... it's in final tuning. Shame it can't go to space.
Abnormal energy readings from the lab...
So these are Getter Rays...
So that Getter Robo is getting even more powerful.
That sounds promising.
Yes.
And the Teleport Machine sent Joe's group off somewhere...
And with Raideen and Grendizer gone, too. We're grateful for it, but...
Amuro?
Is something... worrying you?
Yes. With this much energy here...
why has the enemy never once come after it?
Ever since we went to retrieve the Getter Robo,
the Saotome Lab hasn't been attacked once... Could it be?
You're overthinking it, Captain Amuro.
Maybe they're just scared of the Getter, y'know?
...Are they?
I see what Captain Amuro's getting at. In that case...
I see. That would certainly explain the timing...
What? What? What're you talking about?
Let's see... Cham,
say there's something you want, and you have the materials for it.
And say you know someone who can make it.
...Would you take the materials and make it yourself?
Huh? I dunno what it is, but if it's hard, I'd have them make it... Oh!
Exactly. If they're coming... it'll be now.
An enemy attack? I see. The enemy's no fool, either.
Ngh...! I had a bad feeling about this...!
Right on the money! These guys are easy to read.
Heh, saves us the trouble of going to them!
...Maybe they're getting desperate.
Kosuke... whaddaya mean?
The Demon Empire, the Campbellians...
The forces on Earth are gradually dwindling.
With their rivals gone, it's a chance for them, but at the same time,
they have less strength left to beat us with.
So it's do-or-die. For both sides...!
Fwahahaha! By Emperor Burai's order, that new Getter is ours!
You think we'd just roll over and say "Sure, go ahead"!?
Do you really think we'd just let you do that?
Then we'll simply take it by force.
Try it, if you can.
In the name of the Hyakki Hundred, I'll take it no matter what!
Showing up right when we're short on strength!
Dr. Saotome, how's Getter G's launch coming along!?
Just a few more minutes! Ryo, Hayato, Benkei,
get on board and stand by!
This waiting's killing me! Hurry it up, Doc!
I'd hate to get crushed just sitting here, y'know?
...Everyone, we're counting on you...!
What's that? It looks like a cowboy.
Hey! Hold it right there!
Who are you!?
Professor Saotome! Me is Jack King!
Gandor Team's in a pinch, so me flew all the way from America!
I am Mary King. Hyakki Empire! Texas Mack shall be your opponent!
I see, the super robot Dr. King built...!
Please! Lend us your strength!
Leave it to us! Let's go, Mary!
All right, Brother!
What? Some weird guys just showed up. Are they on our side?
Looks like it.
No time to dawdle! We're heading out too!
Nngh, this is terrible... The Getter Dragon...!
Hmm... impressive, for something built by mere humans.
A transmission!? Who's there!
Fwaha... I'll grant a dying man's request.
I am Burai. Ruler of the great Hyakki Empire, Emperor Burai...!
Burai...!? Even if you steal Getter G,
no one but its pilots... the ones I chose... can handle it!
Even if I fall, those who carry on my will shall surely destroy you...!
Admirable, not begging for your life. But... that alone won't win a war.
Fear not,
I shall put your efforts to good use... for the Hyakki Empire!
Ryo, Hayato, Benkei... Gandor Team... you didn't make it in time...!
Emperor Burai... leave the rest to me.
Very well. I will not tolerate failure, Marshal Hidler.
Yes, sire! I'll bring Getter G back safely, even if it costs my life.
Are we too late!? What about the lab?
Doctor, are you all safe!?
We're safe, somehow. But... the Getter Dragon...!
Dragon!?
That's the new Getter you've been developing, right?
Yes, but...!
Don't tell me, that new Getter is...!?
Fwahahaha, it's too late to come waltzing in now!
Go! Getter Dragon!
Tch, the enemy's pretty good, I'll give 'em that.
We can't let them take the Getter Dragon...! Destroy it!
What did you say!?
There's no other choice! As long as the lab's intact, we can repair it!
This is no time for second thoughts!
Tch, things never go the way you want!
To think we have to destroy the very thing we came to get...!
Better than letting the enemy use it...
Destroy the stolen Getter first, and wipe out the Hyakki Empire!
All units, launch!
...Looks like we've got no choice. Ryo, Benkei...!
...All right, let's do it! We'll show you that a Getter's strength
depends on its pilots, Hyakki Empire!
Curses, I'm withdrawing. Emperor Burai... forgive meee!
You know what this means, Marshal Hidler...
Yes, sire! I'll begin preparing the next move the moment I return.
You know what this means, Marshal Hidler...
Yes, sire! I'll begin preparing the next move the moment I return.
...Final check... good! Get Machines, launch!
Here we gooo! Hayato! Benkei!
Ready when you are.
Let's go out with a bang...!
Chaaaange Dragon!! Switch on!!
Nngh... they launched it before we could seize it...
But I must bring it back, no matter what!
The Getter Dragon...! All right! Ryoma, let's finish this in one go!
That's the plan, Koji! Let's show them what we can do!
The Getter Dragon, huh... I trust you can handle it, Ryo.
Heh, Tetsuya, just watch and see!
I wasn't worried in the first place...!
Damn, he got away...
That talk about preparing the next move bothers me, though...
Whatever. If we take out Emperor Burai here, it's all the same.
Reinforcements...? Tch, they just keep coming!
Gwahahaha! You're better than I thought, Gandor Team!
It seems... I have no choice but to set that in motion!
Wh-What!? That giant four-legged thing...!?
It's different from the Hyakki mechs so far...!?
My name is Burai... Emperor Burai of the Hyakki Empire!
I have come to teach you lowly humans the depth of your folly.
Bigger isn't always better, you know!
Still... something that big...
Oh, come on. Show! Get it together!
Shorty's right.
Big or small, superior or lowly, none of that matters.
Geez, "lowly," huh. Ain't your mouth the only big thing about you?
...Let's get this over with...!
Damn right! Don't talk big, you lousy invader!
Then learn the Combined Hyakki Robot's power... through death!
Burai! I'll throw those words... right back at you...!
To inflict such damage on this Combined Hyakki Robot...!
You're not to be taken lightly! But even so, you'll never win.
Big talk after that beating! Come back when hell freezes over!
...Do underground demons even get that expression?
Sore loser... What a pathetic oaf, for all that size!
That's all he amounts to.
Squawk all you like... soon enough you'll be crying and wailing...!
Wahahahaha!
It still just sounds like sour grapes to me...
...You think so...? It actually bothers me.
Right, we'll head to the next point while readjusting Getter Robo G!
Commander Hazuki... we're counting on you.
Yes, we'll do everything we can...!
Phew, I wasn't sure how that'd turn out.
That ogre sure caused a fuss, honestly.
Jack, Mary, you saved our hides. Thanks a bunch.
No problem! Professor Hazuki, Texas Mack will fight with you too!
We look forward to working with you!
Yes, I just received word from Dr. King.
In an emergency like this, we'd be glad to have you.
The Yoma, the Campbell gang, now the Hyakki... they've learned.
Things are going great!
Ain't that the truth. Bring 'em on, I say!
Hey, hey, Hyoma, Juzo! Don't get careless, okay?
Hm...? Something on your mind?
No, it's just... this whole thing feels like an omen of something.
An omen? Well, sure, that big one was a threat...
A parting shot like that... there's something behind it.
Norris...?
When a man rages and swears revenge, his backing is usually thin.
But... that composure.
Besides that giant robot... there's still something else?
No, it's merely conjecture. My own, mind you.
Worrying won't get us anywhere. We've retrieved Getter Robo G.
I don't know what'll happen with the colony...
but we have to do our job.
The Captain is right. If the colony were to fall to Earth...
chaos would ruin our defense here. We act now. Gandor, launch.
